description: Read pregame player props at every book GetOdds carries for one sport, merged per player, stat and game day: FanDuel, DraftKings, BetRivers, Pinnacle and Novig prices (American odds; Novig is the exchange ask), PrizePicks, Underdog and DK Pick6 lines, the median line, best over and under, a no-vig fair price and pick’em gaps. Available to every key. Quotes with history=true work with get_prop_history.
